name: The Angry Scytheclaws
summary: South of the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends hunters to face the savage scytheclaws stalking the Barrens. Bring sunscale raptor feathers to their breeding nests, and prove your courage in a land that gives little quarter.

sections.title: A Test of Nerve
sections.body: Sergra Darkthorn tests hunters against the beasts of the Barrens. After lesser trials, she sends you south of the Crossroads to hunt vicious sunscale raptors and take their feathers. Then you carry those feathers southwest of the Stagnant Oasis, into the heart of raptor territory. Placing them in the nests is the true test: it shows you can face the scytheclaws without fear.

sections.title: The Scytheclaw Nests
sections.body: Three raptor nests lie southwest of the Stagnant Oasis, near the Gold Road. Red, blue, and yellow eggs mark the separate clutches. Scytheclaws defend their nests fiercely against anything that comes near. Place the feathers of fallen raptors among the eggs, and you make your challenge clear to the beasts.

sections.title: Tempered by the Savanna
sections.body: Return to the Crossroads after entering the nests, and Sergra can see you have faced the danger and lived. Walking out of a raptor den takes raw courage. The Barrens test every hunter; each fight may harden you, or leave your bones among the kodo ribs scattered across the dirt.

faq.q: Why does Sergra Darkthorn want me to put feathers in the raptor nests?
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn asks you to show courage and dominance. Kill sunscale raptors, then place their feathers in the colored clutches to show their pack and kin that you do not fear them.

faq.q: Where are the scytheclaw nests located?
faq.answer: The nests are south of the Crossroads and southwest of the Stagnant Oasis, near the Gold Road. They lie beside a small hill marked by giant kodo bones, just east of the roadway ditch.

faq.q: What kinds of raptors live in this part of the Barrens?
faq.answer: Sunscale scytheclaws and their kin live here. These cunning, aggressive reptilian predators hunt in packs and fiercely defend their clutches around the Gold Road and nearby Raptor Grounds.

faq.q: Where do I collect the Sunscale Feathers?
faq.answer: Sunscale raptors and scytheclaws across the plains south of the Crossroads and the nearby Raptor Grounds toward the eastern hills carry Sunscale Feathers.
Sergra Darkthorn is an experienced orc stationed at the Crossroads. She tests arriving Horde adventurers with trials across the Barrens, measuring their survival instincts and fighting discipline.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to other hunts?
faq.answer: Yes. Sergra Darkthorn's hunts continue across the Barrens, ending with the hunt for Isha Awak, the legendary sea beast off the Barrens coast.

angles.text: As a hunter, you test your wilderness mastery when you enter a territorial predator's den and challenge its dominance.
As an orc, you know that surviving Durotar and the Barrens takes strength, fortitude, and unwavering nerve.
As a member of the Horde, you know the raptor packs along the Gold Road threaten caravans and lone messengers traveling between the Crossroads and southern outposts.
